title: Be respectful.
body: No harassment, personal attacks, hate speech, or threats.

title: Stay on topic.
body: Post about FEH, Fire Emblem, or this website. No spam or advertising.

title: Use the right flair and megathread.
body: Use active megathreads for summons, Binding Worlds, and Hall of Forms. [MOD] flairs are for staff only.

title: Add useful details.
body: Explain builds, teams, strategies, and new hero ideas. Link sources for news and label speculation.

title: Keep it safe.
body: No explicit content, scams, malicious links, or private information. No cheating tools or account trading.

title: Credit creators and mark spoilers.
body: Link original creators, respect reposting restrictions, and keep story spoilers out of titles.

title: Respect moderation.
body: Follow staff guidance and GitHub rules. Ask staff about moderation decisions politely and include the post link.
